name: carpe-diem
description: Venice AI models (text, image, video, speech, music, embeddings, web) at Carpe Diem marketplace prices: TEE-only /v1 or best-price /router, spend guards, optional x402 pay-per-call on Base.

CARPE_API_KEY.description: Carpe Diem API key (cdm_…). Without it, only free tools work unless x402 is configured.

CARPE_MAX_SPEND_USD.description: Session spend cap in USD (default 5, 0 = off).

CARPE_X402_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Agent wallet key for x402 pay-per-call (used only without CARPE_API_KEY).

CARPE_X402_BUDGET_USD.description: Required with CARPE_X402_PRIVATE_KEY: total USDC the escrow may ever pull.
